description: Pre-reranking retrieval baseline for Phase 3. Sourced from docs/adr/0011-hybrid-scoring-evaluation.md (Phase 2 final evaluation). Chunking strategy: Hierarchical (child_chunk_size=400, parent_chunk_size=1500). Embedding model: Google Gemini (dense), Qdrant/bm25 via FastEmbed (sparse). Fusion: Qdrant RRF.

phase3_target.note: Phase 3 reranking goal: improve Recall@1 of hybrid (0.76) to match or exceed dense (0.83). Hybrid already achieves top Recall@5, so reranker should focus on promoting the best result to rank 1.
